notes: Each checked edition has its own entry. Platform and edition variants are listed separately.
Road is a fan game detected as Day of the Tentacle; its identity is not an official ScummVM game ID. Passport to Adventure is a demo compilation.

The untested list includes Excellent, Good, and Bugged upstream ratings. It excludes Broken and Untested ratings, engine groups, and alternate versions. Games with a tested edition are omitted; sequels, annual releases, and episodic parts remain separate. The upstream chart groups some supported games instead of listing each title individually.
